Press Releases

    198 Results

    DHL Express Announces Annual Price Adjustments in the U.S.

    DHL Express, the world’s leading international express services provider, announced a 5.9% general average shipment price adjustment for U.S. account holders that will take effect on January 1, 2027.

    DHL Supply Chain Launches New Logistics Solution for U.S. Health Systems

    Built for modern health systems, which encompass hospitals, physician groups, and outpatient facilities, the offering brings inventory and medical support activities together in a consolidated service center and connects the center to points of care through dedicated transportation and final-mile delivery. 

    DHL Supply Chain Expands Service Logistics Capabilities to Accelerate Data Center Infrastructure Parts Delivery

    The expanded data center logistics network speeds up delivery of mission-critical installation and replacement parts to key facilities in hours rather than days.

    DHL Awards Ultimate Small Business INDYCAR Sweepstakes Prize to FLATED Following Nationwide Promotion for U.S. SME’s

    FLATED’s logo will be prominently displayed on the No. 10 DHL Chip Ganassi Racing Honda driven by four-time INDYCAR champion and 2025 Indianapolis 500 winner Alex Palou, and its leadership will receive a VIP race weekend experience, courtesy of DHL.

    U.S. Shoppers: Speed, Trust, and Transparency Now Decide Online Purchase

    The report, based on responses from 1,000 U.S. shoppers across generations, reveals a market where expectations for speed, trust, and seamless experiences continue to accelerate.

    General Motors Names DHL Supply Chain North America a 2025 Supplier of the Year

    The award recognizes suppliers that demonstrate exceptional performance across key categories including safety, execution, resilience and customer support, as evaluated by a global GM team.

    DHL Highlights North America’s Trade Resilience Ahead of USMCA Review, Sees Opportunities and Competitiveness from Trade Agreements

    This comes as policymakers from the United States, Mexico, and Canada prepare for the 2026 Joint Review of the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA). 

    DHL Partners With Stasher to Offer Convenient Luggage Storage and Shipping Solutions for Travelers

    Through this partnership, travelers can securely store luggage at participating DHL ServicePoint and DHL Premier Partner locations across the U.S. 

    DHL eCommerce and USPS Enter $10 Billion - Plus, Long‑term Exclusive Agreement

    At an expected value well over $10 billion (USD), the agreement is unprecedented in the 25-year DHL eCommerce-USPS relationship and positions both organizations for long-term competitive success.

    DHL Supply Chain Announces Leadership Appointments to Advance Strategy 2x30

    Jim Monkmeyer, currently President, Transportation, DHL Supply Chain North America, has been appointed Global Head of LLP & Supply Chain Orchestration, DHL Supply Chain, effective immediately.

    Manage Consent Preferences

    Strictly Necessary Technologies

    Always Active

    These technologies are used to ensure that our website operates correctly and they cannot be deactivated.

    Performance Technologies

    These technologies collect information about the way our website is used, such as the Internet browser and operating system used, domain name of the website from which you accessed our site, number of visits, average time spent on the site and pages viewed.

    Functional Technologies

    These technologies allow the website to remember choices you make and provide enhanced, more personal features. For example, these technologies can be used to remember and store the last tracking number that you entered when using a tracking application. Information these technologies collect may be anonymized and they cannot track your browsing activity on other websites.

    Analytics Technologies

    We use analytics technologies to improve the quality of our website and its content, and to ensure that our partners’ embedded services work properly.

    YouTube Technologies

    YouTube technologies are used when users call up web pages that play embedded YouTube videos. Youtube.com is a Google-owned video hosting and sharing platform. Youtube.com collects user data through embedded videos, which is aggregated with data from other Google services in order to display targeted advertising to website visitors.

    Marketing Technologies

    These technologies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these technologies, you will experience less targeted advertising.

    Google Maps Technologies

    We use Google technologies to ensure that the Google mapping data used in the location finder is displayed correctly and completely. These technologies may incorporate data transfers in countries without an adequate level of data protection. The map in the location finder cannot be displayed unless you accept these technologies.

    Bing Technologies

    We use Bing technologies to ensure that the Bing mapping data used in the location finder is displayed correctly and completely. The map in the location finder cannot be displayed unless you accept these technologies.
